rows.text:
Wrong question. 
Right questions:
1- Which Diseases Should Have Been Eradicated? 
Answer:
- Cholera
Water chlorination and modern sewage systems kill the bacteria instantly.
- Typhoid Fever
Clean plumbing completely stops its spread through contaminated water.
- Polio
Safe, highly effective vaccines…

rows.text:
I don't see COVID on the list, so it needs to be added; at the start of the pandemic, the use of hygiene measures was underestimated, yet they ended up becoming the standard for preventing infection and spread.
Best regards!
